If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to be named as the champion of NBA for the 2026-27 season per the rules of NBA (e.g., participant is eliminated), the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams are declared winners, this market will resolve in favor of the team whose listed name comes first alphabetically.

If this event is cancelled, postponed after June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or a champion has not been declared within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

eventMetadata.context_description: The tight clustering of implied probabilities around the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs underscores their deep young cores, recent Western Conference contention, and multi-year windows built around established stars and supporting depth. Trader consensus has held these two near the top amid stable outlooks following the 2025-26 season, with limited major roster upheaval. Eastern Conference developments, including LeBron James joining the Philadelphia 76ers and the New York Knicks entering as defending champions, have lifted those sides into the next tier while keeping the overall field competitive. Broader league parity, driven by emerging talent across multiple franchises and ongoing roster adjustments, sustains uncertainty for longer-term futures like the 2027 title.
